extracted.name: Easy Fresh Peach Pie
extracted.description: Fresh, sliced peaches are layered in a pre-baked crust with a thick glaze made of pureed peaches for a wonderful treat. Chill and serve with ginger ice cream.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups fresh peaches, pitted and mashed
4 cups fresh peaches - pitted, skinned, and sliced
instruction_lines: Combine sugar, water, cornstarch, butter or margarine, mashed peaches, and nutmeg in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until clear and thick. Stir in vanilla.
Fill pie shell with sliced fresh peaches, alternating with the glaze. Refrigerate.
